answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. Hardware-signed execution quotes per key; a farm of clones shares one TPM and one quote fails the count. A willow of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the sonnet of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and prism-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
